flags.message: Country borders are not drawn into the terrain images. The viewer draws them from the same Natural Earth data as the 2D map. A teacher must review how disputed borders are shown.
Elevations and lengths in these files are for drawing. Numbers shown to children come from the pack's approved facts.
Traced course, 758.9 km. Compare previews/river-tana-river.jpg with a trusted map before approval.
